parsed.rationale: Not normal: leads II, III and aVF show Q waves with clear convex ST elevation of more than 1 mm, aVL and I show reciprocal ST depression, and V2–V3 show ST depression suggesting the posterior wall is also involved, so this is an acute inferior STEMI.
